description: Subscribe a URL (must be a public https URL) to (a) new EUR-Lex documents matching searchCriteria and/or (b) changes to watched acts (watchCelex: amendments, corrigenda, repeals, new consolidated versions). Checked hourly; deliveries are free and HMAC-signed. The signing secret is returned ONLY in this response — tell the user to store it. Plan limits apply (FREE has no webhooks). Confirm the URL and criteria with the user first. Free.

searchCriteria.description: Filters for documents.new, in the lex_search vocabulary.

dateFrom.description: Lower bound on the document date.

dateTo.description: Upper bound on the document date.

query.description: Words that must all appear in the title (whole words; 4+ characters match word starts; trailing * for prefixes).

subdomain.description: Replaces the default (EU law, no consolidated texts); "consolidated" = consolidated texts only.

secret.description: Own signing secret; generated when omitted.

url.description: Must be a public https URL (port 443 or 8443, a public domain name or address); it receives the POSTs.

watchCelex.description: Base acts to watch (not consolidated versions or corrigenda).
